m: The {Zookeeper} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Island} lighthouse with a *lance* and a baby *tree* under one arm. He stabs the lance into a flowerpot, drops the sapling into the hole and yells "**Plant**!" Seagulls bring him seeds, and he keeps going until the whole roof is **planted** like a jungle.

The {Jockey} gallops across the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} where a *fortune teller* sits reading the clouds. Suddenly *water drops* patter on her crystal ball, and she licks her thumb to **moisten** each page of her prophecy book. Soon the jockey, the horse and the whole future are **moistened** and dripping.

The {Jockey} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} like a *jack-in-the-box*, springs wobbling. A *small speech bubble* over his head says "Free massage!", but when guests lie down he steals their towels and slippers. Everyone shouts that he **cheats**, and the spa bans him for **cheating** at bingo too.

The {Jockey} sits on the {Rooftop} of a hut on the {Island} beside a monk with a long *beard* and a *tattoo* of an empty bowl. Coconuts fall and fish leap into the monk's lap, but he won't eat a bite: he has sworn to **fast**. By day ten the jockey's stomach growls so loudly that he joins the **fast** just to annoy it.

The {Magician} tiptoes down the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} carrying a stolen cake. A giant painted *eye* on the wall follows him, so he drapes his cape over it to **conceal** what he is doing. He hides the cake inside his top hat, but forgets to **conceal** the crumbs in his moustache.

The {Baker} is painting the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} when a *crouching tiger* leaps out of a cardboard box. He swats it with a brush of black *bristles*, and every swipe leaves a dark band on its orange fur. The tiger admires its brand-new **tiger stripes**, and the café cats queue up for **tiger stripes** of their own.

The {Ghost} drifts up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and finds a *trapped man* wedged under a fallen bookshelf, waving a tiny white flag of **distress**. The ghost tries to lift the shelf, but its hands pass straight through. So it wails at the top of its lungs, and the whole village hears the call of **distress**.

The {Zookeeper} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} with a *queue* of bees stretching round the chimney. Each bee buzzes into his *mouth*, asking whether honey can be spicy. He has no idea, so he opens a fat encyclopedia to **consult** an expert, and the queen bee flies up to **consult** him about her crown.

The {Firefighter} slides down the pole into the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, where a spinning wheel sits inside a chalk *square*. She feeds it a fluffy cloud, the wheel whirs, and out comes *silk thread* by the mile. She can't stop it: it **spins** and **spins** until every plane upstairs is wrapped like a parcel.

The {Gardener} lifts the {Trapdoor} beside the {Swan Pond} and finds a *heron* stuck head-first in a *clay jar*. He tugs its legs, it honks, and the swans cheer him on. With a loud pop the bird flies free, still wearing the **jar** like a helmet, and now every swan wants a **jar** hat too.

The {Tailor} digs a *tunnel* out of the {Basement} of her shack by the {Lagoon}, and seawater gushes in. She chops down a *tree*, stitches the planks together with her needle and makes a **bucket**. All night she bails, **bucket** after bucket, while curious fish swim through the tunnel to watch.

The {Robot} clanks into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} wearing an *embroidered robe* and dragging a sack of *soil*. It tips the dark earth across the floor, plants potatoes in the fresh **soil** and waters them with motor oil. By morning the basement is a farm, and the robe is caked in **soil** up to the collar.

The {Gardener} hauls a sack of *rice* up to the {Rooftop} of the {Tower}, followed by a hungry *lamb*. She grinds the rice, bakes a giant **cake** inside the chimney and sticks candles on top. Before she can sing, the lamb leaps in face-first and eats the whole **cake**, frosting and all.

The {Sailor} bursts out of a {Trapdoor} on the jetty of the {Lagoon}, right in the middle of the *town square*. He unrolls a *page* as long as a sail and bellows an **ode** to his little rowing boat. Pigeons gather, fishermen weep, and the mayor orders the **ode** carved into the fountain.

The {Pirate} stomps up a vine {Staircase} in the {Jungle} under a full *moon*. With every *drumbeat* from the village below, his belly puffs up a little more, until he is **swollen** like a beach ball. He floats off the steps and bobs over the treetops, his **swollen** belly booming like a drum.

The {Shepherd} leads his flock up the icy {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave}, and every sheep has a *small speech bubble* singing a different note. The yeti roars, then joins in, and suddenly they sing *all together*. The cave fills with such **harmonious** baaing that even the icicles chime along, perfectly **harmonious**.

The {Lifeguard} spots a flood wave and dives into the {Basement} of the boathouse on the {Lake}. She grabs a *brick pile* and shovels *soil* against it with her flippers, building a **rampart** across the doorway. The waves crash, the ducks cheer, and her muddy **rampart** holds.

The {Gardener} on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} house finds an *antique* drinking fountain shaped like a giant *mouth*. She turns the brass tap and it doesn't spray: it just goes **gurgle**, **gurgle**, gurgle. Bubbles float out, and every swimmer below starts to gurgle along like a choir of frogs.

The {Shepherd} chases a lamb down a *hillside* onto the {Beach} and steps on a {Trapdoor} hidden in the sand. It splits with a loud **crack**, and he gets wedged in sideways. Through the narrow **crack** he spots crabs having a tea party, and the lamb squeezes in to join them.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} hugging a *bundle* of red *chili* peppers. She tosses them into the hot tub, and the water turns **spicy** at once. Guests leap out with steam whistling from their ears, and even the rubber duck breathes fire: far too **spicy**!

The {Baker} chases a map of his whole *country* that keeps blowing around the {Basement} of the {Hangar}. He catches it and winds *silk thread* round and round to **tie** it to a propeller. Then, overexcited, he **ties** up the flour sacks, his own shoes and his sleepy assistant, until nothing in the basement can move.

The {Chef} keeps a baby *dragon* in the {Basement} of his hut by the {Lagoon}, under a *roof* lined with silk pillows. He **pampers** it shamelessly: fresh fish on silver plates, bubble baths, foot rubs. The dragon burps a little flame of joy and demands to be **pampered** again at midnight.

The {Hunter} climbs out of a chimney onto the {Rooftop} of a cabin by the {Lake}, face black with *soot*. Only his *mouth* shows, and he shouts "**Hey**!" at a passing boat. The fishermen think a talking chimney is calling them, so they yell "**Hey**!" back and paddle away fast.

The {Dentist} opens a {Trapdoor} in the floor of the {Waiting Room}, and up pops a *money changer* behind a cash drawer. Patients line up to **exchange** their pulled teeth for shiny coins. One grandpa **exchanges** all his false teeth at once and walks out rich, grinning a toothless grin.

The {Magician} sits on the soggy {Staircase} down to the {Lake} after a week of *rain*. His top hat has sprouted green fuzz. A *busy mother* rushes past with a mop, scrubbing furiously, but the **mold** grows faster than she cleans, and soon even the rabbit in the hat wears a little coat of **mold**.

The {Tsar} marches proudly across the {Warehouse} and falls straight through a {Trapdoor}. He lands on a *sitting pair* of guards eating soup, and his crown rolls away: a royal **setback**. A *helping hand* lowers a rope, he climbs halfway, then the rope snaps: another **setback**.

The {Juggler} balances on the {Rooftop} of a {Beach} hut, tossing a *grain stalk* in one hand and a magnifying glass in the other. Farmers pass up whole sheaves, and he must **check** every kernel for beetles. He gets so fussy that he **checks** the seagulls' feathers too, and drops everything onto the sand.

The {Firefighter} rolls a *cart* down the {Staircase} into the {Pool}, and its wheel collapses. She pulls chopsticks from a *full jar* and jams them between hub and rim as new **spokes**. The cart squeaks back up the steps on twenty wobbly **spokes**, dripping water everywhere.

The {Cheerleader} finds a *beggar* living in the {Basement} of a {Beach} café. He holds out a seashell and **begs** for a single chip. She waves her pompoms and starts a chant, and soon the whole beach is **begging** on his behalf, until the seagulls drop him a mountain of chips.

The {Sheriff} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} rolling a *pinch* of cotton between his fingers. It stretches into *silk thread*, then into thick **yarn**, then just keeps growing. By sunset he has lassoed every bathrobe on the washing line with one endless strand of **yarn**.

The {Cheerleader} climbs a sandy {Staircase} up the {Dunes} and meets a grumpy *lord* whose *shirt* is so long it reaches his ankles. The wind catches it and he spins like a top. She cheers, and he realises his shirt has become a swirling **skirt**. Now every camel wants a **skirt** too.

The {Shepherd} sits on the {Rooftop} of a {Beach} hut, beating a *joy drum* for his sheep. Each beat tickles them, and they **giggle**. He covers his own *mouth* to stay serious, but the drum keeps thumping, and soon he is rolling across the roof, **giggling** until he falls off into the sand.

The {Wizard} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} and lifts a glowing *jade tablet* to the sky. Fireworks burst out of it in the shape of bathtubs. Every guest in the hot pool below opens their *mouth* and shouts "**Wow**!", and the rubber ducks quack "**Wow**!" too.

The {Shepherd} lifts the {Trapdoor} of the {Youth Hostel} and finds a sheep holding a needle in its hoof. It is **embroidering** a pink *blossom* onto every pillow with *silk thread*. The backpackers wake with flowers stitched onto their socks, and the sheep starts to **embroider** the shepherd's beard.

The {Jockey} falls through a {Trapdoor} in the {Hangar} and twists his ankle. A *tree* growing down there bends politely and snaps off a branch, handing him a *walking staff*. He hobbles out leaning on the **staff**, then uses the **staff** to whack the trapdoor shut behind him.

The {Tailor} sweeps the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} and spills a sack of *sugar* into a hole in the *soil* outside. It rains, the hole fills, and a sweet **pond** appears. Frogs leap in, ducks sip it like syrup, and by noon the **pond** is so sticky the frogs can't jump out.

The {Yogi} meditates in the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, right where four tunnels meet like a *crossroads*. A pipe bursts, *water drops* splash on his head, and the puddle starts to **spread out** down every tunnel. Calmly he lets his arms and legs **spread out** too, and floats away on his back.

The {Jockey} drives a *cart* down the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse}, bumping every step, until the **axle** snaps in two. The wheels roll away into a *sprouting field* and plant themselves. Next spring a forest of wheels grows there, each one spinning on its own little **axle**.

The {Pirate} wants the treasure on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion}, so he bolts a giant *climbing frame* to the wall. He starts to **climb**, parrot on his head, cutlass in his teeth. Halfway up the frame wobbles, but he keeps **climbing**, reaches the top and finds only a pigeon's egg.

The {Baker} kneads dough on the {Staircase} of the {Fort} under the *moon*, so hard that his **upper arm** swells like a loaf. A herald reads a *proclamation*: whoever has the biggest **upper arm** becomes captain. The baker flexes, his sleeve bursts, and every soldier salutes.

The {Pirate} pops out of a {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and meets a *pioneer* with a map. "Show me how to find treasure," he growls. The pioneer's *speech bubble* fills with drawings: "For **example**, dig here." He digs and finds a boot. "Another **example**, here!" Boot number two.

The {Baker} serves tea on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} to a huge *warrior* with a poem *tattoo* across his chest. The warrior lifts his cup with his little finger out, recites verse and bows: so **refined**! The baker, dusted in flour, tries to look **refined** too and pours the tea into his own shoe.

The {Cheerleader} runs down the wooden {Staircase} to the {Beach} and drops her *axe* in front of a *small altar* built of shells. She kneels to **pray** for sunshine on the day of the big game. The clouds only rumble, so she **prays** louder, shaking her pompoms, until the sun pops out and sneezes.

The {Tailor} naps on the {Rooftop} of a {Beach} hut until a *lizard* crawls up her trouser leg. Her *kicking foot* goes wild: one **kick** sends the lizard flying over the sea. It lands on a surfboard, rides a wave back and dares her to **kick** it again.

The {Sailor} bursts out of a {Trapdoor} in the {Beehive}, his *flowing locks* full of honey, waving a huge *writing brush*. He paints wild poems across every wall, splashing ink on the bees, totally **unrestrained**. The queen bee joins in, and soon the whole hive dances, **unrestrained**, until bedtime.

The {King} wanders into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} and lets out an enormous *yawn*. The *soil* under his feet yawns back, opening into a deep **pit**, and down he tumbles, crown first. From the bottom of the **pit** he yawns again, and it gets even deeper.

The {Juggler} rises through the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} on a *cart* with no wheels, carried by four cats on *stilts*. He waves from his **sedan chair** like an emperor while juggling teacups. The cats wobble, the **sedan chair** tips, and he lands face-first in a bowl of cream.

The {Pirate} and his *buddies* march up a vine {Staircase} in the {Jungle}, chop down one *tree* and hammer it into a **shed**. It has three walls and a leaky roof. When the rain comes they all squash inside the tiny **shed** with a parrot, a monkey and a very annoyed toucan.

The {Cheerleader} stands on a *podium* on the {Beach} when a {Trapdoor} opens beneath it and drops her into the sand. She lands in second place and starts to **sob**. Her tears fall as *water drops* that fill a bucket, then a paddling pool, and a crab sits in the puddle and **sobs** along with her.

The {Lifeguard} patrols the {Basement} of the {Museum}, where a *lying man* keeps sliding off a bench. A woman with a *tall bun* catches him again and again, **repeatedly**. The lifeguard blows her whistle **repeatedly**, the man slides off **repeatedly**, and the bun grows taller with every rescue.

The {Zookeeper} waits by the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} for the morning *birdsong* to finish so he can feed the parrots. But the birds sing on and on. His *kicking foot* taps, stamps, then bangs the trapdoor: he is so **impatient**. The parrots copy him, stamping their claws, the most **impatient** choir in the world.

The {Cheerleader} leads a cheer on the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Hostel}, which sits on a tiny *hillock* at the foot of a huge *hillside*. Her whole family joins in, shouting "Q-I-U!" because that is their name, **surname Qiu**. Sheep on the hillside bleat it back, and the mailman delivers every letter marked **surname Qiu** to the hostel.

The {Hunter} creeps up the {Staircase} of a hut in the {Swamp} and finds a *golden crown* resting on a *small table*. It bursts into flame, and out of the fire rises a **phoenix**, shaking ash off its wings. The hunter drops his net in awe, and the **phoenix** puts the crown on its own head and flies away.

The {Yogi} pops up through a {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} carrying a *spilling dish* that never stops filling with *water drops*. He tries to hold it still, but it **overflows** onto his toes, then the sand, then the sea. Soon the whole ocean **overflows**, and surfers ride waves straight out of his little dish.

The {Jockey} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room}, where a *tree* grows with a trunk made of knobbly bones. A *sparrow* hops up it, bone by bone, tapping each **vertebra** like a xylophone. The jockey's own spine starts to sing along, every **vertebra** clicking in tune.

The {Zookeeper} runs up the {Staircase} of the {Spa}, a sweaty *headband* round his forehead and a *stone* in each hand. A nut that no monkey can open sits on the top step. He lifts the stone high and **smashes** it: crack! The monkeys cheer and start to **smash** coconuts, flowerpots and the spa's fancy mirrors.

The {Tailor} is a *runner* carrying clothes from the *attic* to the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar}, one shirt at a time. Up, down, up, down: each **trip** takes ten minutes. By dinner she has made three hundred trips, and the pilots beg her to take just one last **trip** with all their uniforms.

The {Lifeguard} jogs up the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} into a dark *cave* where the money is counted. Customers keep peeking, so she hangs a beach *towel* across the opening as a **curtain**. A gust blows the **curtain** open, and a bat is sitting there counting coins.

The {Firefighter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion}, which has floated out to sea in a flood. The *sail* on the chimney is ripped, so she ties a giant bath *towel* to the flagpole as a new **sail**. The wind fills it and the whole mansion races across the waves, its fluffy **sail** puffed out proudly.

The {Cheerleader} cartwheels across the {Rooftop} of a {Beach} hut, where a *tree* sprouts from the chimney. At sunset a hundred parrots fly home to the *bird nest* at the top and **perch** in a row. There's no room left, so the cheerleader climbs up and **perches** too, squawking along.

The {Tsar} lifts the {Trapdoor} by the {Swan Pond} and peers into a smoky *cave* where a mouse is roasting a *kebab*. Startled, the mouse **flees** with the kebab, and the tsar chases it round and round the pond. Then the swans see the tsar's crown flapping and they **flee** too, honking.

The {Wizard} stumbles down the {Staircase} of the {Mansion}, juggling a tiny magic *pill*. He drops it, and it grows into a huge bouncing **ball** that thunders down every step. The butler dives aside, the chandelier swings, and the **ball** rolls out the front door and down the hill.

The {Jockey} drags a carrot as tall as a horse down into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} and slaps it on a *chopping block*. Whack! He **chops** it in two with a cleaver. Then he gets carried away and **chops** the wardrobe, a broom and his own riding boots into neat slices.

The {Dentist} stands on the {Rooftop} of a {Beach} café as the tide rises. She shovels *soil* into a long wall along the sand and marks its height with a *tick mark* on a stick. The sea crashes against the **dike**, the café stays dry, and she fills the cracks in the **dike** like cavities.

The {Tailor} lands a hot-air balloon on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa}, which is made of nothing but dried *soil*. A pigeon with *drooping wings* lands next to her. The roof sags, groans and **collapses**, and they drop straight into the hot tub. Then the walls **collapse** too, and everyone is bathing in mud.

The {Firefighter} slides down through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and finds a *rebel* selling *shells* from a suitcase. "I **deal in** shells," he whispers, "rare ones." The firefighter buys a shell that sings, and soon the whole mansion is crawling with people who **deal in** seashells.

The {Shepherd} climbs a *cliff* to the {Rooftop} of the {Stadium} and finds a *lookout* tower with a little door. Behind it is a cosy **side room** with a sofa, tea and a sleeping sheep. He takes the best seat in the **side room** and watches the whole match through the window.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} beside a manhole cover. A *helping hand* reaches up and **lifts** it, and a sheep pops out with a wide *grin*. Then another hand **lifts** the whole roof like a lid, and the bankers below look up, blinking at the sky.

The {King} relaxes in a steam bath on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} when a *guest* climbs in beside him. The steam goes up the guest's nose, and out of his *mouth* comes a dry **coughing sound**. The king copies it, the bath bubbles copy it, and the roof echoes with a royal **coughing sound**.

The {Gardener} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Wine Cellar}, where a *thousand ants* sit in neat rows facing *north*. Not one wiggles. She drops a sugar cube, and still they sit, so **well-behaved**. She hands each ant a tiny gold star, and the snails nearby pretend to be **well-behaved** too, hoping for one.

The {Magician} sits on the {Staircase} down to the {Beach} when a *lost traveller* stumbles up asking the way. The magician only answers with a *small speech bubble*: "What has sand but never tells the time?" The traveller scratches his head over the **riddle** for hours, while crabs queue up to hear the next **riddle**.

The {Ninja} sneaks onto the {Rooftop} of the {Yeti Cave} and scoops up a lump of *black mud*. With a *helping hand* from the yeti, she **pinches** it into a tiny snowman, then **pinches** its nose into a sharp point. The yeti laughs so hard that she pinches his furry cheek too.

The {Yogi} meditates at the foot of the {Staircase} of the {Mansion}, beside an iron *gate* with the name **Yan** carved on it. A visitor creeps through and drops straight into a *trap pit*. From the bottom a voice booms: "Who dares enter the house of **Yan**?" The yogi does not even open one eye.

The {Baker} rows his boat to the {Rooftop} of the {Inn}, which now stands at the very edge of the sea. Waves splash *water drops* over the tiles. A *guest of honour* in a shiny sash steps out, and the baker serves him buns on the wet **shore**. A seal wants a bun too and flops up onto the **shore**.

The {Lifeguard} hears splashing in the {Basement} of the {Pool} and finds a *tiger* doing backstroke. She flexes her *strong arm*, flings a rubber ring and **captures** it in one throw. The tiger sulks, wearing the ring like a necklace, while the swimmers cheer the great **capture**.

The {Sheriff} sits on the {Front Step} of the {Beehive}, locked out. He has no **key**, only a honey *spoon*. He bends it, twists it, scratches a *tick mark* on the handle and jams it into the lock. Click! The spoon has become a **key**, and the bees invite him in for tea.

The {Lifeguard} walks down the {Staircase} into the {Pool} and finds it full of tall *grass* growing from the water. She pushes through the **reeds** to a hidden *door*. Behind it a frog plays a tune on a hollow **reed**, and the lifeguard blows her whistle along.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} into the {Boxing Ring}, where the floor is covered in *grass*. His opponent is a giant red **apple** wearing boxing gloves. One punch, and the pirate is *flat* on his back. The **apple** takes a bow, and the hungry crowd cheers and starts to eat it.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Yeti Cave} on the back of a tired *porter* loaded with sacks of wool. The porter groans and starts to **unload**: wool, two sheep, a sofa and finally the shepherd. The yeti helps **unload** the rest and builds itself a fluffy bed.

The {Jockey} rides into the {Basement} of the {Tower}, where *water drops* drip from the ceiling into a muddy **pond**. A *town crier* stands knee-deep, ringing his bell: "Hear ye! Frogs wanted!" Frogs arrive by the hundred, and the jockey's horse wades into the **pond** to join them.

The {Yogi} skates in circles over a locked {Trapdoor} in the {Ice Rink}. He tries to bribe it with *gold coins*, but it won't budge. Then the *moon* drops a thin silver **key** through the skylight. He turns the **key**, the trapdoor swings open, and a line of penguins skates out.

The {Jockey} parks his horse on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool}, where a *tree* grows out of the diving board. He paints *red lacquer* round and round the **tree trunk** until it shines like a fire engine. The horse scratches its back on the wet **tree trunk** and comes away bright red.

The {Dentist} kneels in the {Basement} of the {Tower} before a *small altar*. She sets down a *longevity peach* and whispers a **prayer** for healthy teeth across the land. The peach glows, rises into the air and starts brushing its own stone. Her **prayer** has worked.

The {Pirate} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} holding a fish with a *spitting mouth* that squirts seawater in his eye. He grabs a *standing knife* and **cuts open** the fish to find a treasure map inside. He **cuts open** a second fish and finds a second map, pointing back at the first.

The {Shepherd} lights a bonfire on the {Rooftop} of a {Beach} hut, and the *embers* fly up into the night. Their *glow* spreads until the whole sky turns **bright** as noon. The sheep put on sunglasses, the owls complain, and the moon squints down at the **bright** little roof.

The {Hunter} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Water Park} with a crate of *fireworks*. He lights them, and instead of whooshing they rocket into the metal slides: **clang**! **Clang**! Every swimmer's *mouth* drops open, and a lifeguard bangs a saucepan to join the clanging.

The {Pirate} and a bearded *pioneer* stand on the {Rooftop} of a {Beach} hut, arguing over a coconut. The pioneer pulls out a huge *knife* and **hacks** it in two. The pirate wants a turn, so he **hacks** at the roof, the door and the palm tree until the whole hut is firewood.

The {Cheerleader} peeks through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave}, her *standing heart* thumping like a drum. She is far too **timid** to shout a single cheer. When the yeti waves hello, she squeaks and dives for the *exit*, and the yeti, just as **timid**, hides behind an icicle.

The {Tailor} sews a *lampshade* on the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} when a small red **crab apple** drops into her lap from a pilot's pocket. She bites it, and it is so sour her face freezes in a *blank stare*. The pilot laughs, and she pelts him with **crab apples** all the way down the steps.

The {Gardener} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} under the *moon* when a *visitor* climbs up a wobbly ladder. He offers his **arm** to steady her, and she grips it so hard that his **arm** stretches like toffee. It stretches all the way up to the moon, and he waves at it.

The {Jockey} lands on the {Rooftop} of a sinking *farmstead* in the {Swamp}. Thinking fast, he cuts down a *tree* and hammers it into a sharp **stake** beside the chimney to prop the house up. It still sinks, so he hammers **stake** after stake, until the roof looks like a hedgehog.

The {Gardener} weeds a flowerbed on the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} and digs up a glowing **precious stone**. At once a *ghost* swirls up and moans that it belongs to the *king*. The king himself arrives by ladder, and the three of them squabble over the **precious stone** until it rolls down the drainpipe.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Museum} beside a *woman* who is a real *loudmouth*. She tells jokes to the statues, and the yogi tries hard not to be **amused**. Then she juggles a mummy's bandages, and even the dinosaur skeleton is **amused**, rattling with laughter.

The {Cheerleader} hears music in the {Basement} of the {Museum}: a knight in armour wants to **marry** a *woman* in a painting. A *grabbing hand* pulls her out of the frame, he kneels, and the cheerleader throws confetti. The mummies weep with joy, and soon everyone wants to **marry** someone by midnight.

The {Magician} opens the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort}, and *water drops* spurt up as high as a *treetop*. He waves his wand to stop them, but they turn to **foam**. White **foam** pours from every window, and the soldiers slide down the walls as if it were a bubble bath.

The {Sailor} sings sea shanties in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} until his **throat** is raw. A friend pops a *mulberry* into his *mouth*, and it slides down cool and sweet. Now his **throat** is so smooth that his next high note shatters a plane's windscreen.

The {Dentist} sneaks onto the {Rooftop} of the {Casino} for a snack. She tucks in her *kicking foot* and **squats** low behind the chimney, nibbling *toast*. A row of pigeons **squats** beside her, begging for crumbs, and the security guard mistakes them all for gargoyles.

The {Firefighter} rushes up the {Staircase} of the helter-skelter at the {Funfair} as a *campfire* below sets a *grove* of candyfloss trees alight. The sugar starts to **burn**, smelling of caramel. She sprays her hose, but it is full of lemonade, and the grove **burns** on in a fizzy pink glow.

The {Tailor} stands on the {Staircase} of the {Tower}, swirling *pottery* bowls in a bucket of *water drops*. She means to **wash** away the mud, but gold sparkles appear at the bottom. Delighted, she **washes** every pot in the tower, then the stairs, then the bewildered mayor.

The {Ninja} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} into a hot-dog stand. A *woman* there is cooking for a shouting *drill sergeant*. He bites a sausage so **tender** it melts, and his face goes soft too. He stops shouting, hugs everyone and says his heart is **tender** as well.

The {Yogi} pops out of a {Trapdoor} in the {Dunes} playing *music* on a sand-filled flute. Every line he sings must **rhyme**, so he hands the camels *even shares* of words: "sun", "fun", "run". One camel tries "banana" and the whole song falls apart. The yogi glares until it finds a proper **rhyme**: "bun".

The {Chef} climbs out of a {Trapdoor} at the {Funfair}, his *shirt* lined with candyfloss to keep him warm. He sticks his *thumb* inside to show off the fluffy pink **lining**. Then the rollercoaster whooshes past, the wind tears it out, and children chase his **lining** across the fairground, eating it.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Club} and puffs out his *chest* to sing the anthem of **Hungary**. His chest swells bigger and bigger, until it is shaped like a map of **Hungary**, with a river down the middle. The teenagers below salute and ask for goulash.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of a palace in the {Dunes}, juggling *gold coins* while the sultan shares them out in *even shares*. Each coin weighs as much as a camel: truly **great**. He catches the last one, the roof cracks, and he sinks into the sand with a **great** thud.

The {Sheriff} stands on a *podium* in the {Pool} when the {Trapdoor} under it springs open. Instead of falling, he shoots straight up, stiff as a flagpole, perfectly **vertical**. Swimmers stare as he hovers above them, and he refuses to come down until every diving board is **vertical** too.

The {Juggler} pops up through a {Trapdoor} at the top of the {Dunes} and sees a *mountain* so **steep** it leans backwards. A *handsome man* in climbing boots grins and starts up it. Halfway, the slope gets even more **steep**, and he slides down on his bottom, still grinning, still handsome.

The {Baker} opens the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} and a *badger* jumps out, wanting to be fierce. The baker dips a *ladle* in chocolate and dabs spots all over its fur. Now it's a **leopard**! It prowls proudly around the bakery, roaring, until it licks itself and turns back into a badger, a very sticky **leopard**.

The {Lifeguard} leans off the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} with a giant net, because a *labourer* has dropped his lunchbox into the moat. A *helping hand* holds her ankles as she dips in to **fish up** the box. She also **fishes up** a boot, a bicycle and an angry eel.

The {Juggler} tiptoes up the {Staircase} of the {Museum} carrying a *handful of rice*. He throws it onto a patch of *grass*, and every grain bursts into a golden **chrysanthemum**. The curators gasp, the paintings sneeze, and the statues wear a **chrysanthemum** behind each ear.

The {Baker} hides in the {Basement} of a {Beach} villa, where a snooty lord studies a *village plan*. He points at the farmers on the *hillside* and sniffs: "I **despise** them, and their muddy boots." The baker throws a cream pie at him, and now the lord **despises** pastry too.

The {Pirate} falls through a {Trapdoor} in the {Fort} and lands on a sleeping *ghost*. With a yelp, his **soul** pops out of his chest as a *white dove* and flutters around the room. The ghost catches the bird in its hat and politely hands the pirate back his **soul**.

The {Dentist} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} and stretches her *legs*. Her trousers have a magic **pocket** on the knee. She pulls out a toothbrush, then a canoe, then a whole lighthouse, and finally a tiny fisherman who asks to go back into the **pocket**.

The {Hunter} kneels in the {Basement} of a hut by the {Lagoon}, where a baby crocodile is sulking. He puts his *joined hands* together, opens his *mouth* and sings a soft song to **coax** it out from under the bed. It works, so he **coaxes** the whole crocodile family out with marshmallows.

The {Yogi} sits in the {Basement} beneath the {Boxing Ring}, reading a single *page* of puzzles upside down. While the boxers above punch each other, he solves every one in a second: so **clever**. He folds the page into a paper boxer that wins the championship. Even the referee admits it is **clever**.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar}, landing on a *roadside* stall that sells *gold coins*. Each coin is stamped with a crown and worth one **pound**. He buys a loaf with one, and the change is another **pound**, and another, until coins pour out like flour.

The {Shepherd} trips through the {Trapdoor} into the {Yeti Cave} and smashes a framed *portrait* into tiny **bits**. A *lying man* on the sofa sweeps them up, but the yeti sneezes and blows the **bits** everywhere, gluing them into a new picture of a sheep.

The {Yogi} lies in the {Basement} of a {Beach} hut when a *bug* marches in wearing a wig like a *judge*. It bangs a crumb and sentences the yogi to share his sandwich. It is a tiny **ant**, and a thousand more **ant** jurors carry the sandwich away.

The {Hunter} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Pool}, beside an old *scholar* holding a round teapot. The scholar tips the **pot**, and tea pours out without stopping, filling the pool. The swimmers float on their backs sipping, and the scholar says the **pot** is only half empty.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} to a wooden *stage* on the {Beach}, where a band plays only for him. His *standing heart* dances, his toes wriggle in the sand, and he grins: he is so **pleased**. The crabs clap their claws, also very **pleased**, and the band plays an encore.

The {Sheriff} hides some *ginseng* roots under the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} ghost train. But it rains, and *water drops* begin to **seep** through the wooden boards. The ginseng tea **seeps** into the ghost train, and every skeleton suddenly feels young and dances out of the tunnel.

The {Tailor} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool}, trying to sew a wig for a man with a *bald head* that shines like a mirror. The sun bounces off it and blinds the swimmers. She plonks the wig on top, but a seagull steals it, and he is **bald** again, gloriously **bald**.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of a temple in the {Piazza}, where a monk walks a long *road* chanting. Each chant makes a *plus sign* of light in the sky, and the bells ring a deep **Buddhist sound**. The juggler hums along, and the pigeons coo the same **Buddhist sound**.

The {Hunter} opens the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} to find the cellar lake bone-dry. Up above, the *sun* has shone for a year, and the laundry on the *drying rack* is crisp as crackers. It is a terrible **drought**: the goldfish are sunbathing on rocks, and the hunter prays for rain to end the **drought**.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort}, tying a *promise knot* in a rope. It slips, tightens round his toe, and his *mouth* pops open: "**Oh**!" He tugs harder, and the knot tightens on his other toe. "**Oh**, oh, oh!" The soldiers below think it's a song and join in.

The {Shepherd} trips down the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} with a sack of *salt* that bursts open. Salt pours over the counters and coins. The banker licks his finger, winces and says the money tastes **salty**. Now even the cash machine spits out **salty** notes.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} when a strange bird lands on the *goal line* painted across the roof. It asks: "**How** do I get to the sky?" The yogi points up. The bird blinks and asks, "Yes, but **how**?" and they sit there puzzling until dark.

The {Cheerleader} hides in the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} when a *dispatch rider* gallops in carrying a letter from the boss. A *small speech bubble* bursts out of it shouting, "You dropped the gold!" The boss arrives to **reprimand** her in person, and then **reprimands** the horse for muddy hooves.

The {Wizard} sits in the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, stirring a *rice bowl* with his wand. The rice floats up and swirls around the room, **as if** it were snow. Then he blows, and it drifts back down softly into the bowl **as if** nothing happened.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} straight into a flooded field of **paddy rice**. She pulls a *grain stalk* from the mud and scoops the kernels with a *rice scoop*. The ducks join in, planting rows of **paddy rice** with their beaks until the tower floor is a farm.

The {Jockey} drops a pile of *gold coins* through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} into a bubbling furnace. He pours the melted gold into a mould shaped like a *longevity peach* and **casts** a golden fruit. It is so pretty that he **casts** a golden horse to match.

The {Dentist} opens the {Trapdoor} by the {Swan Pond} and finds a sweaty *blacksmith* hammering *gold coins* on an anvil. Clang, clang: he **forges** them into a swan-shaped crown. The swans queue up, and he **forges** a crown for each one, plus golden braces for the dentist.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Piazza} clock tower. A *standing person* below holds up a sign with a big *plus sign* on it, and every time it flashes the crowd yells the syllable **ga**. The juggler tosses balls in time: **ga**, ga, ga, until the pigeons shout it too.

The {Jockey} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion}, trapped under the *eaves* by a talkative bat. The bat explains his whole family tree, every cousin, in detail, for six hours: so **verbose**. The jockey falls asleep, wakes, and the bat is still going, even more **verbose** than before.

The {Baker} opens a {Trapdoor} on the {Beach}, and the *twins* find a deep *grave* where an old pirate is said to **die** each night and come back at dawn. Sure enough, the pirate climbs out yawning, eats a bun, then lies down and pretends to **die** again with a dramatic groan.

The {Hunter} wakes in the {Basement} of a hut in the {Swamp}, where a strange *light* drifts through the fog. His *standing heart* flutters, and everything looks **hazy**: the frogs wear hats, the mosquitoes play cards. He rubs his eyes, but the room stays **hazy** and the frogs wave.

The {Baker} is called down to the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange}, where the boss swaps his golden *shell* badge for a bicycle with a *flat tyre*. He has been **demoted** from head baker to crumb sweeper. Then the boss accidentally eats a burnt bun and **demotes** himself.

The {Jockey} creeps down the {Staircase} of the {Pool} at night with a tiny *campfire* stuck on top of a wax stick: a **candle**. A *bug* flutters round and round the flame, dizzy. The jockey sneezes, the **candle** goes out, and the bug glows on its own to light the way.

The {Hunter} rides a *horse* across the {Island} when a *wild boar* bursts out of a {Trapdoor} in the ground. The horse rears and neighs, completely **startled**, and the hunter lands in a palm tree. The boar, equally **startled**, dives back through the trapdoor and slams it shut.

The {Shepherd} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} peeling an onion the size of a sheep. Layer after layer of *grass* comes off, and at the very centre he finds a beating *heart*: the onion's **core**. It whispers that it is shy, so he wraps the **core** back up in leaves.

The {Jockey} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} and squeezes an orange on a *cross*-shaped press. Sticky *water drops* dribble out as sweet **juice**. The bees swarm in, dunk their heads, and soon they are buzzing in zigzags, dizzy on **juice**.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} beside the {Swan Pond} and sees a *tree* so wide it fills the *horizon*. Its berries are **soapberry** fruit, and when the swans peck them, bubbles foam everywhere. The hunter rubs a **soapberry** on his muddy boots and they come out sparkling.

The {Firefighter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar}, looking down at a narrow **lane** of *soil* between rows of *square* houses. A fire engine is stuck in it, too wide to move. She lifts the houses one by one like boxes until the **lane** is wide enough to drive through.

The {Lifeguard} leads a small grey *horse* up the {Staircase} of the {Museum}, but at the *door* it plants its hooves and won't budge. It is a stubborn **donkey**. She tries carrots, music and pleading, then gives up and buys the **donkey** its own museum ticket.

The {Shepherd} hides in the {Basement} of the {Youth Hostel}, leaning on an old *tree* trunk holding up the ceiling. He blows a *puff of breath* on it, and it crumbles like biscuit, completely **rotten**. The backpackers' beds drop down beside him, and the floorboards turn out to be **rotten** too.

The {Juggler} climbs out of a {Trapdoor} in the middle of the {Boxing Ring}, ready for a fight. But *moss* covers the ropes and the old *podium*, and the boxers are napping in their corners. Everything is so **peaceful** that he juggles feathers instead, and the crowd hums a **peaceful** lullaby.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Rooftop} of a hut by the {Lagoon}, leaking water everywhere. He decides to **hire** help, and a *standing person* climbs up with a *bucket*. Each time she bails, the yogi pays her one coconut, and soon he has to **hire** her whole family.

The {Robot} clanks into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a *woman* sits beside a fountain of *water drops*. It bows and speaks in old poetic style: "**Thou** art fair." She giggles and replies, "And **thou** art rusty." The robot blushes and squirts oil.

The {Lifeguard} rushes past the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool}, so **busy** she cannot stop: hauling *stone* blocks, filling in her *logbook*, blowing her whistle, rescuing a duck. She runs in circles until the trapdoor opens and swallows her. Even underground she stays **busy**, scribbling notes.

The {Cheerleader} drops through the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} onto a long dusty *road* where a *beggar* is walking. She cheers him on, step after step, **until** he reaches the sea. Then he keeps walking **until** the waves reach his nose, and she hands him a snorkel.

The {Juggler} pops out of a {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} wearing a *strange mask* and pointing *north*. "To **Hebei**!" he shouts, and he juggles his way up the coast past Beijing. When he arrives, everyone in **Hebei** wears the same mask and juggles back.
